style.icon: chunky clean pixel art in the style of 16-bit SNES-era JRPG inventory icons, bold dark outline around every item, simple readable silhouette that stays clear when shrunk to 32x32 pixels, slight three-quarter top-down view, limited palette with clean highlights and darker shading
style.original: original designs, no logos or symbols from existing franchises or brands
style.keyBg: Solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling everything around and between the items; the items themselves must not use any magenta or hot-pink #FF00FF color
style.noText: no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no captions, no watermark, no grid lines, no cell borders, no frames, no drop shadows
style.world: a cozy fantasy-tech JRPG world where cute AI spirits live

sheet.empty: Cells after item {count} stay completely empty plain magenta.

categories.ball: a round high-tech capture orb: a smooth glossy sphere whose main shell color is {colorName} ({color}), with a large glowing hexagonal core lens in the center of its front, framed by two thin vertical metal ribs that arc from the top of the sphere to its bottom, {detail}

chip.template: a small square microchip skill cartridge card whose body color is {colorName} ({color}) with lighter highlights and darker shading of the same hue, a row of gold contact pins along its bottom edge, a dark rounded border, and on its face one simple glowing emblem: {motif}
